audit.whatIsWrong: The entry is built on Blinding Dart shutting Zac down: whys[2] "his Q blind neuters Zac's auto damage", spikes[0] "shuts off your auto-reliant trades", early "his Q blind shuts off your auto damage".
audit.why: Blind stops basic attacks. Zac's damage is Unstable Matter (a percentage of max health, magic, 5s cooldown), Elastic Slingshot and Let's Bounce! — all abilities, all unaffected. Teemo's single defining spell is close to a dead card against this specific champion, and the entry treats it as the reason the lane is lost. The full layer already half-knows this ("E-knock his kite (ignores blind)") and the content layer contradicts it.
audit.corrected: Re-scoped the blind to basic attacks and moved the real threat to Move Quick kiting plus Toxic Shot chip.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] "his move-speed passive kites Zac's approach" and spikes[0] "his passive stealth plus move speed" both attribute movement speed to Teemo's passive.
audit.why: The passive is Guerrilla Warfare — invisibility while stationary, plus an attack-speed burst on breaking it. The movement speed is Move Quick (W), a 14-second ability. That matters because a cooldown can be baited and a passive cannot: Move Quick being spent is Zac's actual engage window.
audit.corrected: Re-attributed to Move Quick (W) and turned into the sequencing rule.
sources: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json (P Guerrilla Warfare; W Move Quick, cd 14)

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] reads "Toxic Shot and Noxious Trap (R) shrooms zone the entire lane" and says a shroom "reveals you mid-engage". mid repeats "reveals your flanks".
audit.why: Toxic Shot is the E on-hit poison and has nothing to do with shrooms — conflating them misdescribes both. Separately, I could not verify the reveal claim: Riot's text for Noxious Trap gives slow and damage over time, and the kit file carries no revealsStealth flag, so I removed the assertion rather than restate it.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and mid now describe the shroom slow breaking a flank, with no reveal claim.
sources: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json (E Toxic Shot; R Noxious Trap)

audit.whatIsWrong: diff is "HARD" at 8.5/10 difficulty, and both charts lean Teemo (content 6-1, full 5-2), while Zac wins 52.87% over 174 games.
audit.why: An 8.5/10 HARD rating on a matchup Zac wins is the largest single misread in the entry — it tells players to dodge or play scared in a lane that is slightly favourable.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, difficulty 6.5/10, and both level charts aligned to Teemo/Teemo/Skill/Skill/Teemo/Zac/Zac.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags "NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere". Confirmed.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is 7 seconds flat at every rank — it never gets shorter, which is worth knowing — and Move Quick is 14 seconds. The engage rule is to slingshot once Move Quick is spent, not once the blind is down.

Toxic Shot is on-hit poison scaling with attack speed, so the existing MR-plus-HP direction and the "Stack pure HP vs %damage" caution are right. _missing-interactions.json flags the on-hit itemisation point and the entry already covers it.

edits.before: At 2 his move-speed passive kites Zac's approach.
edits.after: At 2 Move Quick (W) kites Zac's approach away.

edits.before: Level 3 his Q blind neuters Zac's auto damage.
edits.after: Level 3 blind misses — Zac kills with abilities.

edits.before: Through 4-5 his poke-and-kite keep Zac off him.
edits.after: By 4-5 blob sustain outlasts his poke-and-kite.

edits.before: At 6 his shroom field zones and reveals Zac's flanks.
edits.after: At 6 his shrooms zone every flank path Zac wants.

edits.before: First item, his DoT out-damages Zac's slow chase.
edits.after: First item, Zac's HP and MR outgrow Teemo's DoT.

edits.before: Teemo out-poke and blinds you early — his Blinding Dart (Q) shuts off your auto-reliant trades and his passive stealth plus move speed let him kite your slingshot, chipping you down every time you approach.
edits.after: Blinding Dart (Q) stops basic attacks only — your W, E and R all land through it, so Zac is about the worst target it has. What actually hurts is Move Quick (W) kiting your slingshot while Toxic Shot chips you down.

edits.before: Toxic Shot and Noxious Trap (R) shrooms zone the entire lane; stepping on a shroom slows and reveals you mid-engage, so your E flanks get harder and 6 stays firmly his.
edits.after: Noxious Trap (R) shrooms zone the lane, and a slow landing mid-slingshot is what ruins your flank — buy a sweeper and path around them, because 6 is the one level that is firmly his.

edits.before: With Liandry's/Rylai's Teemo's DoT and shroom field out-damage your slow chase; he blinds your autos and kites, so the sidelane pressure is his through first item.
edits.after: Your first item flips it — Heartsteel health plus MR outgrows his DoT, and Blinding Dart does nothing to the ability damage you actually kill him with.

edits.before: Levels 1-5 are all Teemo: his Q blind shuts off your auto damage and his stealth-and-speed passive lets him kite your telegraphed E, so you can't pin him — farm at range and don't waste slingshots chasing.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are Teemo's, but not for the blind — Blinding Dart stops basic attacks only, and Zac kills with abilities. It is Move Quick (W) kiting your telegraphed E that keeps him safe, so don't chase with slingshots.

edits.before: At 6 his shroom field zones the lane and reveals your flanks, making it his strongest window; carry a sweeper, path around the shrooms, and don't force an engage he can just kite out of.
edits.after: At 6 his shroom field zones the lane and a shroom slow mid-engage is what breaks your flank, making it his strongest window; carry a sweeper, path around them, and don't force an engage he can kite.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds your autos. E-knock to close. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: 7s flat at every rank, and it stops basic attacks only — your W and E land through it. - Move Quick (W): 14s, the real kiting tool; engage once it is spent. - Your E: 21s at rank 1, never spend it on chip.

edits.before: Blinds your autos. E-knock to close. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blinds basic attacks only; abilities land. Engage once Move Quick is spent.

notes: The biggest correction in this entry is that Blinding Dart barely applies to Zac. Related: the full layer's tldr and winCon still read "His blind + %HP + kite — build MR, E-knock his kite" and "E-knock his kite and build MR. Track Blinding Dart before every commit" — the tracked ability there should be Move Quick, but I left both alone because a rewrite that keeps within +/-10% would have had to drop either the MR instruction or the tracking instruction. Worth a follow-up pass. I did not restate the "shrooms reveal you" claim anywhere: Riot's Noxious Trap text gives slow and damage over time only, and the kit carries no revealsStealth flag, so it is unverified rather than known-false.
